 Updated: October 31, 2026, 4:30 PM ET | First published: October 31, 2026, 3:07 AM ET Written by Mac Douglass , Senior Editor Dimers' simulation model projects a 52.7% win probability for North Alabama at First Security Field at Estes Stadium.
 North Alabama vs. Central Arkansas college football gameday prediction for Saturday, October 31, 2026. Central Arkansas will face North Alabama in Week 9 college football action at First Security Field at Estes Stadium on Saturday, commencing at 5:00 PM ET.
 Dimers' advanced college football model gives North Alabama a slight edge with a 52.7% win probability over Central Arkansas.
 This article offers a complete North Alabama vs. Central Arkansas prediction , including an expanded look at the predicted score, best bets and picks.
 North Alabama vs. Central Arkansas prediction and odds
 Using innovative machine learning and data, we have re-simulated the outcome of North Alabama vs. Central Arkansas, forming part of our college football predictions coverage. 
 Our famous predictive model currently gives North Alabama a 52.7% chance of defeating Central Arkansas . Our predicted final score has North Alabama winning 26-24 .
According to our model, Central Arkansas (+1.5) has a 50.1% chance of covering the spread , while the over/under total of 48.5 points has a 55.8% chance of going over .

 We have researched the best college football odds in America for this game, which are listed here:
 Spread: North Alabama -1.5 (-102) / Central Arkansas +1.5 (+100)
 Moneyline: North Alabama -117, Central Arkansas +113
 Total: Over/Under 48.5 (-115/+113)
 All odds are correct at the time of publication and are subject to change.

 These picks are based on our probabilities matched against the implied probabilities from the current available odds.
